reason: The text fragment (Exodus 2:16-22) describes Moses meeting the daughters of the priest of Midian at a well. The passage narrates how Moses helps them draw water and rescue them from harassing shepherds, ultimately leading to his marriage to Zipporah. The text contains no reference to: (1) the Hebrew people suffering greatly as a collective, (2) Hebrew leaders, or (3) any assignment of blame to the people for their suffering. The passage is a personal narrative about an individual encounter, not a statement about communal suffering or leadership responses to it.
